kept_items.author: claudeai
kept_items.text: We know this has been frustrating, and we want to give you more certainty about what your plan includes. We are making access standard at 50% usage for the plans that use Fable most intensively. Thank you for your patience over the past several weeks. We're continuing to invest
kept_items.selection_reason: Anthropic resolves the Fable 5 rationing saga by making access standard at 50% usage on heaviest plans. Concrete company policy change.

kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text: GPT-5.6 Sol sets a new state of the art in cybersecurity on “The Last Ones” cyber range. We’re already seeing that capability translate into defensive outcomes: helping teams find, validate, and fix vulnerabilities in real-world code. Put it to work with Codex Security:
kept_items.selection_reason: OpenAI claims GPT-5.6 Sol sets SOTA in cybersecurity and ships Codex Security. Concrete product/capability release.

kept_items.author: AndrewCurran_
kept_items.text: The White House has launched a program called 'Gold Eagle' which will give them more control over American frontier AI releases, and will require explicit government approval over which companies are granted access to new models. Voluntary participation may be coming to an end.
kept_items.selection_reason: Reported White House 'Gold Eagle' program adding government approval over frontier model releases. Major policy move.

kept_items.author: thsottiaux
kept_items.text: GPT-5.6 Sol confirmed to be an extremely good model
kept_items.selection_reason: High-engagement OpenAI-insider endorsement of GPT-5.6 Sol. Strong practitioner signal.

kept_items.author: ArtificialAnlys
kept_items.text: The frontier has opened up: four frontier launches in eight days - Grok 4.5, GPT-5.6, Muse Spark 1.1, and yesterday Kimi K3; six labs now have a model scoring >50 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, up from two in early June
kept_items.selection_reason: Benchmark aggregator quantifies the pace: four frontier launches in eight days, six labs above 50 on the intelligence index.

kept_items.author: enzo_gte
kept_items.text: I've been using Kimi K3 for ~16 hours now. The model is clearly good at a lot of different things (especially frontend), but non obvious reason why people are enjoying it so much is that it clearly does not follow the same rules in terms of safeguards and copyright. Kimi will
kept_items.selection_reason: Distinct practitioner observation on Kimi K3: appeal partly driven by looser safeguards and copyright handling. Different angle from prior launch coverage.

kept_items.author: buccocapital
kept_items.text: The entire AI capex trade depends on guys like this spending $20,000 to build an app that tells them their gym is busy after work
kept_items.selection_reason: Widely shared skeptical take on the AI capex trade's dependence on marginal consumer app spend.

kept_items.author: stedelmanto
kept_items.text: Your next coworker won’t be human. Introducing Oasis: The first virtual office where humans and agents work together. We’re building 1,000 agent teams for free. Comment what you need and we’ll build you an army of agents.
kept_items.selection_reason: Product launch: Oasis, a virtual office for combined human-agent teams. Concrete release with strong engagement.

kept_items.author: shensi
kept_items.text: Launching today: the world’s first fully optimized LLM routing stack that can be embedded directly into your product, Merge Embedded Routing Stack. Model sovereignty is now table stakes for any AI product. Users and companies are demanding full control over the AI models
kept_items.selection_reason: Product launch of an embeddable LLM routing stack aimed at model sovereignty. Concrete release.

kept_items.author: 0xMortyx
kept_items.text: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei: "We're a 1-2 year away from AI zooming past us." 90% of Anthropic's own engineers use Claude to ship code today. 50% of entry-level white-collar jobs gone by 2030 "Our lead Claude Code engineer hasn't written a single line of code in 2 months."
kept_items.selection_reason: Summary of Amodei's latest claims on timelines, internal Claude usage, and entry-level job displacement.

kept_items.author: karlmehta
kept_items.text: Sam Altman explains biology's intelligence bottleneck: understanding a discovery is far easier than making one "We are not that smart and biology is enormously complex." "We can imagine kind of anything."
kept_items.selection_reason: Altman's framing of biology as an intelligence bottleneck where understanding lags discovery. Useful practitioner-facing analysis.

kept_items.author: github
kept_items.text: GPT-5.5 this weekend: 60% off for Copilot Max users and 40% off for Pro+ users. Put it toward a tricky bug, a larger change, or updates across multiple files — wherever you use Copilot. No code or opt-in required. Happy coding.
kept_items.selection_reason: GitHub Copilot weekend pricing move discounting GPT-5.5 for Max and Pro+ users. Concrete company action.

removed_items.author: Polymarket
removed_items.text: BREAKING: Anthropic now projected to announce permanent paid-plan access for Claude Fable 5. 59% chance.
removed_items.selection_reason: Prediction market signal on permanent paid Fable 5 access, complementing the confirmed Anthropic policy shift.

promoted_reserve_items.author: DavidSacks
promoted_reserve_items.text: This is concerning. For the first time, a Chinese model Kimi K3 has taken #1 on the Frontend Code Arena and is scoring at or near the frontier on other benchmarks.
